name: 48-Hour Landing Page Smoke Test
falsifiability_signal: Fewer than 4% of visitors click the pre-order / signup CTA across 150 targeted clicks, signaling insufficient organic demand.
step_by_step_protocol: 1. Build a 1-page landing page on Carrd or Framer describing the core product value proposition and pricing.
2. Insert an active 'Pre-Order / Request Early Access' CTA button that links to an email collection and survey form.
3. Allocate $35 in targeted LinkedIn/Meta or Google search ads driving 100-150 niche prospective buyers.
4. Measure email capture conversion rate and willingness to prepay before writing a single line of production code.

name: Backchannel Reference Triangulation Protocol
falsifiability_signal: 2 out of 3 former employees cite chronic leadership instability, uncompensated on-call overload, or arbitrary comp changes.
step_by_step_protocol: 1. Use LinkedIn search to identify 2-3 former team members who left the target department within the last 6-18 months.
2. Send a courteous 2-sentence note requesting a brief 10-minute confidential informational call about department culture.
3. Ask two specific calibrating questions: 'What was the single most surprising friction after joining?' and 'Under what conditions would you return?'
4. Compare their unfiltered testimony against the hiring manager's pitch.

name: Paid 10-Hour Advisory/Consulting Trial
falsifiability_signal: Working relationship friction, chaotic feedback loops, or realization that daily tasks feel draining rather than energizing.
step_by_step_protocol: 1. Propose a discrete, time-boxed 10-hour weekend advisory contract on a specific technical or strategic deliverable prior to signing a full-time offer.
2. Observe how the team handles asynchronous communication, requirement ambiguity, and revisions.
3. Evaluate your genuine intrinsic energy levels during deep execution.
4. Use the working rapport to calibrate whether full-time transition risk is justified.

name: Concierge / Wizard-of-Oz Manual Service Test
falsifiability_signal: Target customers refuse to pay manual invoice or stop using the manual output after 1 iteration, indicating nice-to-have problem.
step_by_step_protocol: 1. Instead of building automation software, manually execute the service for 3 prospective paying clients using spreadsheets and emails.
2. Send a real Stripe payment link or invoice before delivering finished work.
3. Measure whether the client pays and whether the time spent delivering value is economically sustainable.
4. Document the exact manual steps that software will later replace.

name: 4-Hour Isolated Architecture Prototype Spike
falsifiability_signal: Selected framework or database fails throughput or latency SLA at 10x scale, or requires >3 complex undocumented workarounds.
step_by_step_protocol: 1. Build a bare-minimum repository implementing only the single most contentious technical operation (e.g. distributed write lock, complex query).
2. Run a synthetic load generator (e.g., k6 or vegeta) modeling anticipated peak concurrency.
3. Measure tail latency (p99) and resource consumption under failure injection.
4. Make architectural commit decision based on empirical benchmark logs rather than conference talk hype.

name: Discreet Recruiter Market Pipeline Audit
falsifiability_signal: Zero inbound interview requests at target compensation tier after 15 targeted outreach pings to top-tier specialized recruiters.
step_by_step_protocol: 1. Update resume and LinkedIn headline with specific senior accomplishments and modern keywords.
2. Discreetly reach out to 3-5 specialized recruiters in your metropolitan/remote market asking for active comp bands for your profile.
3. Assess actual employer demand and realistic pipeline velocity before voluntarily resigning from stable current role.
4. Benchmark your runway needs against current real-world average time-to-offer (60-120 days).

name: 12-Month Zero-Income Living Expense Stress Test
falsifiability_signal: Liquid runway covers fewer than 9 months of fixed non-discretionary expenses under worst-case baseline.
step_by_step_protocol: 1. Export last 6 months of bank and credit statements into a spreadsheet.
2. Categorize all expenses into strictly 'non-negotiable fixed' (rent/mortgage, debt, groceries, healthcare) vs 'discretionary'.
3. Calculate pure monthly burn and divide total liquid (cash + short-term Treasury) reserves by this number.
4. If runway is under 12 months, establish a formal spending pause or secondary income bridge before taking speculative risk.

name: 72-Hour Trial Residency & Noise Audit
falsifiability_signal: Unacceptable ambient traffic noise, lack of walkable amenities, or excessive peak commute duration during rush hour.
step_by_step_protocol: 1. Book an Airbnb or short-term stay within 2 blocks of the prospective residential property over both a weekday and weekend.
2. Execute the exact commute to office/school during peak morning (8:00 AM) and evening (5:30 PM) rush hours.
3. Walk the neighborhood at 10:00 PM and 7:00 AM to assess real noise levels, safety, and local density.
4. Talk to 2 local residents about HOA management or neighborhood friction points before signing a 30-year mortgage.

name: 1-Hour Professional Contract & IP Clawback Audit
falsifiability_signal: Non-compete, non-solicit, or broad IP assignment clauses that restrict side projects or future employment options.
step_by_step_protocol: 1. Review the Proprietary Information and Inventions Agreement (PIIA) and offer letter for non-compete clauses and post-employment covenants.
2. If clauses claim 24/7 intellectual property assignment outside work hours, request an explicit written carve-out schedule.
3. Verify accelerated vesting triggers (single-trigger vs double-trigger change-of-control).
4. Consult a specialized employment attorney for a 30-minute review before signing.

name: 5-Interview Pain Point Validation Sprint
falsifiability_signal: Fewer than 2 out of 5 interviewees have actively spent money or time trying to solve this problem in the last 90 days (The Mom Test).
step_by_step_protocol: 1. Identify 5 target users through your existing network or LinkedIn.
2. Schedule 20-minute interviews structured around past behavior: 'How do you currently solve X?' and 'When was the last time you did that?'
3. Never ask 'Would you buy this?' (hypothetical optimism bias); ask 'What did you pay the last time this broke?'
4. If no current makeshift solution or budget exists, pivot the problem definition immediately.
